characters.name: Gilad
characters.description: boy about 7, skinny and energetic, short brown hair, freckles, big hazel eyes, light olive skin, wide-brimmed yellow straw hat, green t-shirt, blue knee-length shorts, white tzitzit strings hanging at his sides, small blue knitted kippah under the hat, red sneakers

characters.name: Shimon
characters.description: neighbor about 65, tall and lanky, bald on top with grey hair on the sides, bushy grey eyebrows, grey stubble, light olive skin, round glasses, black kippah, faded khaki work shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-blue work trousers, brown rubber boots

characters.name: Balbul
characters.description: small grey donkey with very long ears, white muzzle and belly, dark mane standing up, big gentle brown eyes, a rope halter, and a round brass bell hanging on a leather strap around its neck

characters.name: Grandpa
characters.description: Gilad's grandfather about 75, round and cheerful, white trimmed beard, warm brown eyes, light olive skin, white knitted kippah, white Shabbat shirt, dark trousers, reading glasses on his nose

cover.prompt: Gilad in his yellow straw hat leads Balbul the grey donkey by its rope along a dirt path between green moshav fields, laughing, while Balbul stops to sniff a flower. In the distance, Shimon stands at his garden gate shading his eyes. Sunflowers, a chicken coop, cypress trees, warm late-morning light. Cheerful wide shot.

pages.prompt: A small Israeli moshav: green fields, red-roofed houses, a chicken coop with clucking hens, a water tower and cypress trees. Gilad runs through the tall grass with arms spread out like an airplane, his yellow straw hat bouncing, tzitzit flying. Bright sunny morning, wide joyful shot.

In the middle of a field, Gilad stops short, surprised, one hand holding his hat. From behind a big green bush peeks Balbul the grey donkey, mouth open in a loud bray, ears up, looking lost and confused. Medium shot, sunny field, funny surprise.

Gilad crouches close to Balbul, gently lifting the round brass bell on the donkey's neck to look at it; the bell has a small engraved shape of a little house on it, no letters. Balbul sniffs his hat curiously. Close-up, warm light, friendly mood.

Gilad sighs with a gloomy face, shoulders down. Above his head a soft thought bubble shows a memory: grumpy Shimon behind his fence holding Gilad's soccer ball and waving a finger, mouth open shouting. Balbul stands beside Gilad looking at him. Medium shot, slightly cloudier light.

Gilad stands with arms crossed and a sulky pout, turning half away from Balbul, as if about to walk off. Balbul looks up at him with big sad eyes, ears drooping. A dirt path leads away across the field. Medium shot, emotional moment of choice, soft afternoon light.

A warm memory: on a Shabbat afternoon in a cozy living room, Grandpa sits in an armchair reading from a big holy book, with Gilad snuggled beside him listening closely. Shabbat candlesticks on a table and a bookshelf of holy books behind. Shown as a soft glowing vignette, with Gilad in the field in the corner remembering.

Gilad gently picks up Balbul's rope and pats the donkey's neck with a kind, determined smile, saying something softly. Balbul nuzzles his hand. Close two-shot, golden sunlight, the path home stretching behind. A hen pecks in the grass nearby and green fields roll toward the red roofs of the moshav.

Funny journey: along a dirt road between fields, Balbul sits down stubbornly in the middle of the path like a dog, a half-eaten flower still hanging from his mouth, while Gilad pulls gently on the rope, laughing, his straw hat slipping over his eyes. Sunflowers and a little tractor in the background, playful wide shot.

At a green garden gate with a mezuzah on the post, Shimon opens the gate with a sour frown that melts into joyful surprise as he spots Balbul; he throws his arms wide. Gilad stands holding the rope, a bit nervous. Potted geraniums, a fence, Shimon's yard with a lemon tree. Medium shot.

Shimon hugs Balbul around the neck, eyes closed with relief, then glances sideways at Gilad with an astonished, softening expression. Gilad nods shyly, hands behind his back. Warm afternoon light in the yard, close emotional framing. Potted geraniums and a lemon tree frame the moment.

Shimon comes out of his house holding Gilad's old soccer ball, black and white, offering it with a shy, apologetic smile, head slightly bowed. Gilad's face lights up with surprise and joy, hands reaching out. Balbul watches between them. Doorway of a simple stone house, golden light.

A sunny Friday afternoon in Shimon's yard: Gilad and Shimon kneel side by side feeding Balbul carrots from a basket, both laughing. On the low fence behind them sits Gilad's black-and-white soccer ball, and a challah peeks from a shopping bag on a bench. Lemon tree, warm friendly wide shot.

Gilad sits on a fence at sunset with his straw hat in his hands, smiling at the viewer, Balbul resting his head beside him and Shimon waving from his yard in the distance. Golden fields, long shadows, a few birds in the sky. Warm, inviting close-medium shot.
